==Hero Usage==
* Heroes ''will'' use this skill whenever it is charged, severely impacting the rest of their skill bar.

== Notes ==
*The amount of energy loss can be lowered by [[energy hiding]].
*The energy gain of skills such as [[Zealous Anthem]], [[Weapon of Renewal]] and [[Critical Eye]] occurs ''before'' the energy loss.
*Even with the benefit of the auto-critical ignored, this skill has the highest damage increase of any [[axe attack]].
{{Anomaly|The concise description fails to mention that the attack is unblockable}}
